Here are the exact steps in Google Calendar on your laptop (web browser):

3. Click the “Teacher Meeting” event once to open the small popup.  
4. In the popup, click the pencil icon (Edit event).  
5. On the edit screen:

   - Make sure the time is 3:30pm–4:30pm (adjust if it changed).
6. (Optional) Update the description to note the new date if you like.
7. Click the blue “Save” button at the top.  
8. When Google asks “Send update to guests?” click “Send” so the teachers get the new date/time.

If you’d like, I can also give you a short note to paste into the description or email to the teachers explaining the date change.</action>
